messages.subject: [Riskassessment-news] mc2d: New Version (0.1-12) available on CRAN
messages.subject_clean: [Riskassessment-news] mc2d: New Version (0.1-12) available on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
A new version of mc2d (0.1-12) is now avaliable on CRAN. It was mostly a technical update to be in compliance with R 2.14.0... I also fixed a bug in dmultinomial.?
?
?
BUG FIX
????* a bug in the definition of d2V and d3V in the mc2dLmEnglish vignette 
????* a bug in dmultinomial with log = FALSE (the default): it led to NA values 
?
?NEW FEATURES
????* creation of a NAMESPACE for R.2.14 compliance 
????* additionnal xlim and ylim arguments in plot.mc 
?
Enjoy and please share any comments and report any additionnal bugs.
?
R?gis Pouillot
